description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for course-related endpoints, including fetching course catalogs, individual course details with modules, and course modules. It exports a router for use in an Express application.

methods.name: GET /catalog
methods.description: Returns a list of courses (id, title, description, category) ordered by creation date.

methods.name: GET /courses
methods.description: Provides an alias for /catalog endpoint for frontend convenience.

methods.name: GET /courses/:id
methods.description: Returns a single course with its modules. Validates the 'id' parameter as UUID.

methods.name: GET /courses/:id/modules
methods.description: Returns all modules associated with a specified course.
